subject.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Should this focused Nostr fix receive an explicit proof override, or must it wait for a live or otherwise non-mocked delivery capture?
rationale: The implementation and focused checks cover the pre-network boundaries, but repository policy requires real behavior proof for an external non-docs PR and the contributor reports no available relay environment.

options.title: Require Nostr delivery proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until redacted relay output, runtime logs, or an equivalent non-mocked delivery capture demonstrates cleaned mixed text and suppression of trace-only output.

options.title: Grant a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the terminal boundary output and gateway harness as sufficient for this narrowly pre-network change.

recommendation.title: Require Nostr delivery proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until redacted relay output, runtime logs, or an equivalent non-mocked delivery capture demonstrates cleaned mixed text and suppression of trace-only output.
